# Task1

```{r}
# coefficient of glm method
theta_mo <- coef(model1)
theta_mo <- as.numeric(theta_mo)

y <- matrix(data_individ$Resultat, ncol = 1)
X <- model.matrix(Resultat ~ Alder + Kon + Utbildare,
                  data = data_individ)

## Using functions from Part 1
theta0 <- c(0,0,0,0)
max_iter <- 100
for (i in 1:max_iter){
  theta0 <- NR(theta0, niter=1, y, X)
  theta_hat <- theta0
  if (all(round(theta_hat, 2) == round(theta_mo, 2))) {
    break
  }
} 

## Computing AIC
p <- 4
log_Likelihood <- l(theta_hat,y,X)
AIC_f <- -2* log_Likelihood + 2*p
cat("Value of AIC using previous funcitons:",AIC_f,"\n")
cat("AIC value of model1:", AIC(model1), "\n")
```

### The AIC value computed using the previous functions agrees with the value obtained from R.

```{r}
## leave-one-out Cross validation
n <- nrow(X)
log_li_cv <- numeric(n)
tolerance <- 1e-4 
max_iter <- 100    

for (i in 1:n){
    # split sample: training
    X_l <- X[-i,, drop = FALSE] 
    y_l <- y[-i]

    theta_hat <- c(0, 0, 0, 0) 
    for (j in 1:max_iter){
        theta_prev <- theta_hat 
        theta_hat <- NR(theta_prev, niter=1, y_l, X_l) 

        if (all(abs(theta_hat - theta_prev) < tolerance)) {
            break
        }
    }
    log_li_cv[i] <- l(theta_hat, y[i], X[i,, drop = FALSE])
}

log_final <- mean(log_li_cv)
cat("cross-validated average log-likelihood:",log_final,"\n")

AIC_cv <- -2*sum(log_li_cv)
cat("AIC computing from cross-validated method:",AIC_cv,"\n")
```

### The result of cross-validation is very close to the previous value of AIC.

# Task 2

```{r}
## Define post function
post <- function(theta, y, X) {
  eta <- X %*% theta
  p <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta))
  likelihood <- prod(p^y * (1 - p)^(1 - y))
  
  # vague prior: theta ~ N(0, 100I)
  prior <- prod(dnorm(theta, mean = 0, sd = 10))
  
  # Posterior
  return(likelihood * prior)
}

```

```{r}
Xtest <- cbind(1, 18:25, rep(c(0,1),4), rep(c(1,1,0,0),2))
ytest <- c(rep(TRUE, 4), rep(FALSE, 4))
post(c(260, -10, 10, -20), ytest, Xtest) / post(c(270, -15, 15, -25), ytest, Xtest)
```

### The computed value is aligned with the answer given.

# Task 3

```{r}
theta_mle <- coef(model1) # initial values
sigma_step <- summary(model1)$coefficients[, "Std. Error"] # step sizes

# Define log-posterior function
log_posterior <- function(theta, X, y) {
  eta <- X %*% theta
  p <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta))
  log_lik <- sum(y * log(p) + (1 - y) * log(1 - p))
  
  # Prior: theta ~ N(0, 100I) - vague prior
  log_prior <- sum(dnorm(theta, mean = 0, sd = 10, log = TRUE))
  
  # Log-posterior = log-likelihood + log-prior
  return(log_lik + log_prior)
}
```

```{r}
# Data for MCMC
X <- model.matrix(Resultat ~ Alder + Kon + Utbildare, data = data_individ)
y <- data_individ$Resultat

# Metropolis-Hastings Algorithm
N <- 10000  # Number of iterations
n_params <- length(theta_mle)
theta_samples <- matrix(nrow = N, ncol = n_params)
colnames(theta_samples) <- names(theta_mle)

# Initialize with MLE estimates
theta_samples[1, ] <- theta_mle

# Acceptance counter
count <- 0

# Main MCMC loop
set.seed(021120)
for (i in 2:N) {
  # Generate candidate from proposal distribution: N(theta_{i-1}, sigma_step^2)
  theta_star <- theta_samples[i-1, ] + rnorm(n_params) * sigma_step
  
  # Calculate acceptance probability (log scale)
  log_alpha <- log_posterior(theta_star, X, y) - log_posterior(theta_samples[i-1, ], X, y)
  
  # Accept or reject candidate
  if (log(runif(1)) < log_alpha) {
    theta_samples[i, ] <- theta_star
    count <- count + 1
  } else {
    theta_samples[i, ] <- theta_samples[i-1, ]
  }
}

# Calculate acceptance rate
accept_rate <- count / (N - 1)
cat("Acceptance rate:", accept_rate, "\n")
```

```{r}
# Plot parameter traces
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
for (j in 1:n_params) {
  plot(theta_samples[, j], type = "l", 
       main = paste("Parameter Trace:", colnames(theta_samples)[j]),
       xlab = "", ylab = "")
}
```

```{r}
# Plot posterior distributions
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
for (j in 1:n_params) {
  hist(theta_samples[, j], breaks = 30, 
       main = paste("Posterior Distribution:", colnames(theta_samples)[j]),
       xlab = "Parameter Value", probability = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
# Calculate posterior statistics
posterior_means <- apply(theta_samples, 2, mean)
posterior_quantiles <- apply(theta_samples, 2, quantile, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

# Create comparison table
results_comparison <- data.frame(
  Parameter = names(theta_mle),
  MLE = theta_mle,
  Bayesian_Mean = posterior_means,
  Bayesian_CI_Lower = posterior_quantiles[1, ],
  Bayesian_CI_Upper = posterior_quantiles[2, ],
  MLE_SE = sigma_step
)

print(results_comparison)
```

```{r}
# Predict probability for new observation
# My age 22, female, private education
x_star <- c(1, 22, 0, 0)  # Intercept, Age, female, Private education

# Calculate predicted probability
pred_probs <- apply(theta_samples, 1, function(theta) {
  eta <- sum(x_star * theta)
  return(1 / (1 + exp(-eta)))
})

# Calculate posterior predictive probability
posterior_pred_prob <- mean(pred_probs)

cat("Posterior predictive probability of passing test:", round(posterior_pred_prob, 4), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Plot posterior distribution of predictive probability
hist(pred_probs, breaks = 30, main = "Posterior Predictive Probability Distribution",
     xlab = "P(Y* = 1 | y)", probability = TRUE)
abline(v = posterior_pred_prob, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = paste("Mean =", round(posterior_pred_prob, 4)), 
       col = "red", lty = 2)
```
